name: latam_telco
market: Mexico and Colombia, mass-market mobile and broadband provider
density: Dense but organized. Heavy use of full-width color bands separating sections. Many promotional banners for current offers with countdown timers. Prepaid recharge section prominent. Plan comparison tables. Live chat widget. Service status page linked prominently.
nav_style: Full-width top nav in deep teal/blue. Left side: brand logo. Center: main nav links — Móvil, Internet, TV, Paquetes, Empresa, Tiendas. Right side: Mi Cuenta login, help icon, cart icon. Below nav: a promotional banner carousel rotating between current offers with bright colors and large discount percentages.
commercial_model: Consumer telco. Revenue from plan subscriptions and prepaid recharges. Heavy promotional culture: 2-for-1 lines, double data weekends, exclusive streaming bundles. Partner content deals with Netflix/Disney+ included in premium plans.
color_palette: Deep teal (#007B8A) and bright orange (#FF5722) primary brand. White (#FFFFFF) page backgrounds. Yellow (#FFC107) for promotional highlights and countdown timers. Light teal (#E0F7FA) for plan card backgrounds. The palette is energetic and accessible.
typography: Nunito Sans or similar rounded sans-serif — approachable and modern. Promotional headlines very large (40-56px) with discount percentages in oversized bold. Plan prices in huge display type. Body text at 15px. Spanish language throughout with formal 'usted' address.

pages.title: Inicio
pages.description: Full-width hero carousel with current promotions. Below: plan category tabs (Móvil, Internet, TV). Featured plans grid with prices and key features. Streaming partner logos. Recharge widget. Store locator link.

pages.title: Planes Móvil
pages.description: Mobile plan comparison table with GB data, minutes, SMS, streaming inclusions, price per month. Toggle between prepaid/postpaid. Portability CTA. 5G coverage map section.

pages.title: Internet para Casa
pages.description: Home internet plans with speeds in Mbps, price, router included yes/no, installation fee, contract terms. Speed test widget. Coverage checker by address. Installation scheduling.

pages.title: Paquetes Combinados
pages.description: Bundle deals combining mobile + internet + TV. Savings calculator showing monthly savings vs separate plans. Most popular bundle highlighted. Family plan section.

pages.title: Tiendas y Atención
pages.description: Store locator with interactive map. Store hours and services offered. Technical support contact options: phone, WhatsApp, email, chat. Tramites online section to avoid store visit.
